answer: Each identity claims one terrace plot, locks an 80-credit bond, and files a walnut batch at the dune depot. The depot weighs the batch, posts it to a dune ledger, and checks the plot yield band; a mismatch above 10 percent burns the bond. Fees rise with the queue: the k-th filing pays 25 plus 4 times k minus 1 credits, so the 1,000th pays 4,021 and 1,000 fake identities pay 2,023,000 in fees plus 80,000 locked. An honest agent pays 25 once and recovers its bond. A rented-harvest ring fails because batches are keyed to plot and identity, so rented walnuts burn both bonds.
